items.title: What Is Eli Lilly Stock's Biggest Opportunity?
items.summary: Investors are currently valuing Eli Lilly (LLY) stock at a premium, with shares priced at 39.5 times earnings compared with 21.9 for the S&P 500. Justifying that multiple may require sustained growth, yet most of Lilly's sales still come from the company's two dominant blockbusters, Zepbound and Mounjaro. The pharmaceutical maker has a newer drug on sale and expects to launch it in all major markets worldwide in 2027. So what is the new drug, and is it selling.

items.title: What Is Next For Micron Stock?
items.summary: Shares of Micron Technology (MU) have returned 415% over the past twelve months, easily outpacing the 17.3% return for the S&P 500.
